mapper.update: UPDATE assessment_task SET status='DISABLED' WHERE id=#{id} AND training_managed=TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM training WHERE assessment_id=#{id})
UPDATE assessment_task SET training_managed=TRUE WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.sql: a.id,a.created_by,a.name,a.paper_id,a.start_at,a.end_at,a.duration_minutes,a.candidate_scope,a.status,a.allow_retake,a.max_attempts,a.shuffle_questions,a.shuffle_options,a.show_result_immediately,p.name AS paper_name,p.mode AS paper_mode,CASE WHEN p.mode='RANDOM' THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(rb.single_count+rb.multiple_count+rb.true_false_count+rb.short_answer_count) FROM test_paper_random_bank rb WHERE rb.paper_id=a.paper_id),0) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_paper_question pq WHERE pq.paper_id=a.paper_id) END AS question_count

sql.where: a.created_by=#{ownerId} AND a.training_managed=FALSE AND (a.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%'))AND a.start_at >= #{startAt}AND a.start_at <= #{endAt}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount,COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status='SUBMITTED' THEN 1 END) AS gradedCount, AVG(CASE WHEN a.status='SUBMITTED' THEN a.score END) AS averageScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status='SUBMITTED' AND a.passed THEN 1 END) AS passedCount, COALESCE(MAX(a.total_score),0) AS totalScore FROM assessment_attempt a WHERE

SELECT a.id,tp.name AS paperName,COALESCE(NULLIF(ap.candidate_name,''),ap.phone,'匿名考生') AS candidateName,ap.phone,(SELECT r.department_id FROM training_audience r JOIN training t ON t.id=r.training_id WHERE t.assessment_id=a.task_id AND r.phone=ap.phone) AS departmentId,(SELECT r.department_name FROM training_audience r JOIN training t ON t.id=r.training_id WHERE t.assessment_id=a.task_id AND r.phone=ap.phone) AS departmentName,CASE WHEN a.status='SUBMITTED' THEN a.score END AS score,a.total_score AS totalScore,CASE WHEN a.status='SUBMITTED' THEN a.passed END AS passed,a.attempt_no AS attemptNo,a.started_at AS startedAt,a.submitted_at AS submittedAt,CASE WHEN THEN 'VOID' ELSE a.status END AS status FROM assessment_attempt a JOIN assessment_participant ap ON ap.id=a.participant_id JOIN assessment_task at ON at.id=a.task_id JOIN test_paper tp ON tp.id=at.paper_id WHERE a.task_id=#{id} AND NOT ORDER BY ap.id,a.attempt_no,a.idORDER BY a.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS participantCount,AVG(CASE WHEN a.status='SUBMITTED' THEN a.score END) AS averageScore, AVG(CASE WHEN a.status='SUBMITTED' THEN IF(a.passed,100,0) END) AS passRate, MAX(CASE WHEN a.status='SUBMITTED' THEN a.score END) AS highestScore, MIN(CASE WHEN a.status='SUBMITTED' THEN a.score END) AS lowestScore, COALESCE(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,a.started_at,a.submitted_at)),0) AS averageDurationSeconds, COALESCE(MAX(a.total_score),(SELECT p.total_score FROM assessment_task t JOIN test_paper p ON p.id=t.paper_id WHERE t.id=#{id}),0) AS totalScore, (SELECT p.pass_score FROM assessment_task t JOIN test_paper p ON p.id=t.paper_id WHERE t.id=#{id}) AS passScore FROM assessment_attempt a WHERE

SELECT bucket AS label,COUNT(*) AS count FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.total_score<=0 THEN '无有效满分' WHEN a.score/NULLIF(a.total_score,0)<0.6 THEN '0-59' WHEN a.score/NULLIF(a.total_score,0)<0.7 THEN '60-69' WHEN a.score/NULLIF(a.total_score,0)<0.8 THEN '70-79' WHEN a.score/NULLIF(a.total_score,0)<0.9 THEN '80-89' ELSE '90-100' END AS bucket FROM assessment_attempt a WHERE ) s GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY FIELD(bucket,'0-59','60-69','70-79','80-89','90-100')
SELECT CASE WHEN a.passed THEN '已通过' ELSE '未通过' END AS label,COUNT(*) AS count FROM assessment_attempt a WHERE GROUP BY a.passed ORDER BY a.passed DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.submitted_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS label,COUNT(*) AS count FROM assessment_attempt a WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a.submitted_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') ORDER BY MIN(a.submitted_at)
mapper.sql: CASE COALESCE(aq.snapshot_type,qi.question_type) WHEN 'SINGLE' THEN '单选题' WHEN 'MULTI' THEN '多选题' WHEN 'MULTIPLE' THEN '多选题' WHEN 'JUDGE' THEN '判断题' WHEN 'TRUE_FALSE' THEN '判断题' WHEN 'SHORT_ANSWER' THEN '问答题' ELSE COALESCE(aq.snapshot_type,qi.question_type) END

FROM assessment_attempt_question aq JOIN assessment_attempt a ON a.id=aq.attempt_id JOIN question_item qi ON qi.id=aq.question_id LEFT JOIN assessment_answer aa ON aa.attempt_id=a.id AND aa.question_id=aq.question_id WHERE
mapper.select: SELECT AS type,COALESCE(SUM(aa.score),0) AS score, SUM(aq.score) AS fullScore,AVG(CASE WHEN aa.is_correct THEN 100 ELSE 0 END) AS correctRate GROUP BY type ORDER BY FIELD(type,'单选题','多选题','判断题','问答题')

SELECT qi.id AS questionId,COALESCE(aq.snapshot_stem,qi.stem) AS title, AS type, COUNT(*) AS answeredCount,AVG(CASE WHEN aa.is_correct THEN 100 ELSE 0 END) AS correctRate GROUP BY qi.id,title,type ORDER BY correctRate ASC,answeredCount DESC LIMIT 5
